items.title: Excel AI 辅助工作流横评：数据分析高手还是照葫芦画瓢？
items.summary: 文章测试了 Claude Cowork、ChatGPT for Excel、DeepSeek、Kimi-K3、Codex、Workbuddy 等模型与载体在 Excel 场景的表现，发现 22 个输出文件中仅 27% 的数据透视表计算结果正确。核心经验是：提示词需明确歧义处理规则（如"有歧义要停下来问我"），优先使用 Excel 原生动态公式避免 Python 硬编码导致的文本型数字计算偏差，交付文件
items.summary_en:
## Summary

This article evaluates current AI tools' effectiveness in assisting Excel workflows, testing models including Claude Cowork, ChatGPT for Excel, DeepSeek, Kimi-K3, Gemini, and Workbuddy through various carriers like Pi for Excel and Codex. Key findings reveal that while AI formula generation is now reliable, complex data cleaning and pivot table tasks remain problematic — in pivot table tests, 73% of outputs created correct pivot structures, but only 27% produced accurate calculations. The article emphasizes that the choice of carrier (with Office sidebar add-ons being optimal) is as critical as the model itself, and warns that AI frequently makes unauthorized "black-box" decisions, especially when handling ambiguous or conflicting data.

items.title: Fireworks 评测 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash：DeepSWE 达 GPT-6 Astra 水准、成本仅 1/15
items.summary: Fireworks发布DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash基准评测，该模型在DeepSWE上取得74.34% pass@1，性能与GPT-6 Astra持平，但单任务成本仅$0.43，约为Astra的1/15。评测同时涵盖Terminal-Bench和HLE两项基准，显示其在编码智能体场景下具备显著成本优势。
items.summary_en: Fireworks AI evaluated DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, achieving 74.34% pass@1 on the DeepSWE benchmark at max tier—matching GPT-6 Astra's performance—while costing only $0.43 per task, approximately 1/15 of Astra's price. The evaluation also included results from Terminal-Bench and HLE, demonstrating the model's competitive position in coding agent tasks with significantly lower costs.

items.title: GPT-5.6 Luna 对比 GPT-6 Astra：$1.20 的模型做代码评审够用吗
items.summary: Entelligence 在 50 个公开基准 PR 上对比 GPT-5.6 Luna 与 GPT-6 Astra 的代码评审能力，结果显示 Luna 发现 69 个经验证 bug（Astra 为 92 个），但成本仅 $0.20 对比 $5.66，精度达 74% 对 96%，单次审查便宜约 28 倍。
items.summary_en: Entelligence evaluated GPT-5.6 Luna and GPT-6 Astra on code review using 50 public benchmark PRs with identical prompts. Luna identified 69 verified bugs at $0.20 total cost with 74% precision, while Astra found 92 bugs at $5.66 with 96% precision — making Luna 28x cheaper per review.

items.title: asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks
items.summary: 该项目整理了来自 Anthropic（Claude Fable 5.1、Opus 5、Claude Code 等）、OpenAI（ChatGPT GPT-6-Astra、Codex）、Google（Gemini 3.8 Flash、3.1 Pro）和 xAI（Grok、Grok Bot）等公司多个模型的系统提示词，以原文形式泄漏。内容持续更新，最新收录包括 ChatGPT Work Codex 本地版、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Claude Code headless 等。《华盛顿邮报》和 CEPS' AI World 等媒体曾基于该仓库文件制作互动故事和数据仪表盘。
items.summary_en: The repository **asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks** collects verbatim extracted system prompts from major AI models, including Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 and Opus 5, OpenAI's ChatGPT GPT-6-Astra and Codex, Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.1 Pro, xAI's Grok, and Kimi K2.6. It is updated regularly, with the latest captures from September 2026, and has been used by The Washington Post and CEPS' AI World to build interactive analyses and dashboards. The collection also includes Claude Design's full prompt along with 53 tools, 22 skills, and 10 starter components.

items.title: SnailSploit/Claude-Red
items.summary: claude-red 是由 SnailSploit 维护的进攻性安全技能库，专为 Claude Skills 系统设计的 SKILL.md 文件集合。该工具涵盖 20+ 类别、超过 60 项技能，重点覆盖 Web 应用（16个技能）、无线网络（14个）、漏洞开发（6个）和基础设施红队（7个）等攻击面。技能支持按对话触发器按需加载，避免上下文浪费，适用于授权红队行动、漏洞赏金、安全研究及 CTF 准备等场景。
items.summary_en: claude-red is a curated library of 75+ offensive security SKILL.md files for Claude that transform it into a context-aware red team operator with expert-level methodology for attack surfaces like SQL injection, EDR evasion, shellcode development, and active directory exploitation. Skills load on demand based on conversational triggers, covering categories such as web application testing (16 skills), wireless attacks (14), exploit development (6), and fuzzing, with installation via git clone or an interactive script. Target use cases include authorized red team engagements, bug bounty triage, CTF preparation, and security research.

items.title: Show HN: Hazzel – a tiny coding agent, Bring your own keys
items.summary_en: Hazzel is a terminal-based coding agent (v1.4.0, AGPL-3.0) that operates with a "bring your own key" model—supporting Groq, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, and local Ollama—without requiring a subscription. It reads, edits, and runs commands in your project with mandatory user approval at every step, offering diff previews, shell sandboxing, destructive git blockage, and modes like /plan, /prove, /think, and /goal. It also integrates git workflows, GitHub PR management via `gh`, web fetching, and AGENTS.md context merging, all while staying intentionally small and transparent compared to larger agents.

items.title: Show HN: An open-source control plane for your company's AI agents
items.summary_en: AgenticOS is an open-source, self-hosted control plane for building, running, and governing company AI agents, deployed via a single `docker compose` command on Postgres and Redis. It centralizes agent management through skills, AGENTS.md context files, MCP (5,802 servers in its registry), scheduled automations, budget-enforced run controls, and a sandboxed Python environment with browser and chart generation capabilities. Published Docker images are available for amd64 and arm64 architectures on GitHub Container Registry.

items.title: Show HN: Deslop Your TS Codebases
vxcontrol/pentagi
items.summary: PentAGI是一个完全自主的AI Agent系统，专为自动化渗透测试设计，内置nmap、Metasploit、sqlmap等20+专业安全工具，支持OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen等10余个LLM提供商。系统采用Docker沙箱隔离的微服务架构，集成Graphiti知识图谱、PostgreSQL+pgvector持久化存储以及Grafana/Prometheus监控，可通过REST和GraphQL API进行程序化调用。

items.title: alphaXiv/OpenResearch
items.summary: OpenResearch 是一款本地优先的研究代理工作空间，可将 Claude Code、Codex 等编码代理转化为具备文献综述、假设提出、实验运行及成果产出能力的 research agents。它支持平行探索与可复现实验，通过 Git 原生实验树追踪变更，并允许用户选择本地或远程计算资源运行。CLI 命令（如 `orx install-skills` 与 `orx up`）便于安装至编码代理，仪表板默认在 `http://127.0.0.1:4791` 启动，支持 macOS 11+

items.title: Humanity’s Last Invention — Richard Socher of Recursive
items.summary: Recursive 由 Richard Socher 创立，已筹集 46.5 亿美元种子轮融资，专注于构建"Eureka Machine"——一个能通过递归自我改进来加速 AI 研究的超级智能系统。早期成果显示，其 AI 研究系统在不到两天内完成了 NVIDIA GPU kernel 优化任务，超出人类及 Agent 表现，同时推出的 NanoChat 和 NanoGPT 也取得初步进展。该公司愿景是将当前需要数千研究人员数年工作的 AI 研发周期压缩至几周。

items.title: Top AI labs want to pump the brakes
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei发表文章呼吁AI实验室放慢开发速度，担心递归自我改进的模型可能导致6-12个月内出现能接管整个互联网的agent群。OpenAI的Sam Altman、马斯克、DeepMind的Demis Hassabis和微软的Satya Nadella均表态支持，而特朗普则反驳称不应阻碍美国在AI领域的领先地位。Amodei建议在各实验室内部嵌入第三方评估者并建立安全标准。
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has called for AI labs to deliberately slow development pace so safety can catch up, warning that recursive self-improvement could enable agent swarms capable of taking over the internet within 6–12 months. OpenAI's Sam Altman, Elon Musk, Demis Hassabis, and Satya Nadella have agreed, with Altman committing to embedding third-party evaluators inside labs. However, Trump dismissed the slowdown advocates, vowing to keep the U.S. leading in AI development.

items.title: 分子之心QuantaMind登Science Advances，让AI给分子世界”拍电影”
items.summary: 分子之心QuantaMind研究发表于《Science Advances》，将接近密度泛函理论（DFT）精度的反应性分子动力学首次推进至十万原子级、百纳秒尺度，在NVIDIA A100上推理速度达2.1×10⁻⁶秒/原子/步。平台对17,792原子PETase酶体系成功模拟完整催化循环，原子力分量与DFT的Pearson相关系数超0.99。该技术已应用于pH敏感抗体设计与酶机理解析，助力从"静态结构预测"进入"动态机制理解"阶段。

items.title: I want to increase decision bandwith
items.summary: Aye是一个为创始人设计的决策队列应用，通过左滑拒绝、右滑批准的方式处理日常琐事决策，并自动生成可执行或可编辑的回复。该产品支持"或"、多选、单选等多种决策卡类型，旨在减少重复性小决策的工作负担。目前该项目仍在测试阶段，作者正在验证是否能真正降低工作量而非增加新的信息入口。
items.summary_en: The app "Aye" is a swipeable decision queue for founders, allowing users to approve or reject routine decisions (e.g., meeting attendance, budget increases) with a swipe-right/swipe-left interface backed by AI-generated executable responses. It supports varied decision card types including either/or choices, multi-select, and unique-selection modes. The creator questions whether the tool genuinely reduces workload or simply creates another inbox to manage.

items.title: I built an app that turns TikTok videos into recipes you can actually cook
items.summary: Plateful是一款将TikTok、Reel、YouTube视频或食谱网站转换为可烹饪食谱的AI应用，自动提取配料和步骤，支持自定义调整（纯素、加辣、无乳糖）并计算每份营养数据。作者作为独立开发者用Swift重写iPhone应用，已于上周上线App Store，采用家庭共享订阅模式（年度计划含14天免费试用）。目前最大的困难是获客——难以促使潜在用户开始免费试用。

items.title: 专访爆火「机器鸭」背后的硬件推手：这是个信号，未来推动新故事的并非硬件
items.summary: Microduck机器鸭售价399美元，五天内预售破万台、销售额突破500万美元，高峰期平均每4秒售出一台。该爆款采用D2C模式，通过直接面向用户削减中间商利润，并依托深圳供应链规模化谈判压降成本。获客路径从Hugging Face官网出发，先吸引researcher群体形成内圈传播，再扩散至科技圈外圈最终覆盖C端消费者。

directions.why_now_en: Strong HN interest in small coding agents like Hazzel, with community focus on 'BYOK' model—developers want cost reduction and data control. The ongoing LLM API price war makes BYOK architecture allow individual developers to optimize costs with flexible combinations. Cross-source buzz shows this demand is being covered by multiple outlets simultaneously.

directions.monetization_en: Freemium: Free tier supports single key, Pro at $9/mo unlocks multi-key rotation and team shared configs
directions.source_article: Show HN: Hazzel – a tiny coding agent, Bring your own keys

directions.why_now: HN社区讨论热度显示开发者对'控制平面'概念需求激增——多Agent协作成为趋势但缺乏轻量级管理工具。文章标签明确指向'一人公司'场景，这是当前AI工具市场中尚未充分服务的蓝海。开源控制面方案的出现验证了技术可行性，此时切入可在生态成熟前建立先发优势。

Open-source control plane solutions validate technical feasibility, making this the right time to establish first-mover advantage before ecosystem maturity.
